name: promos
recordedFrom: real recorded snippets only (sources per item); text kept as recorded, whitespace collapsed

labelRules.isPromotion: true only when the text states a discount on the store's own price (sale vs its regular/was/original price, % or $ off, code), a free-shipping offer or a free gift; a 'Sale price' label that equals the regular price, 'Best Offer', 'Comparable value' and in-store-only discounts are not
labelRules.kinds: percent_off | amount_off | sale_price | free_shipping | gift | code | in_store | reference_price (set, order-free)
labelRules.percentOff: as stated; a cut-off figure like '(22' isn't a stated percentage
labelRules.salePrice: the offer price when a discount is stated
labelRules.wasPrice: the store's own regular/was/original price for the same item; never a 'comparable value'; null when it can't be tied to the same item
